title: For fight scenes in Seedance, ask an AI chat assistant to generate strong…
content: For fight scenes in Seedance, ask an AI chat assistant to generate strong opening and ending fight prompts, then use those prompts for your video generation.
tips: For fight scenes in Seedance, ask an AI chat assistant to generate strong opening and ending fight prompts, then use those prompts for your video generation.

es.content: Para las escenas de lucha en Seedance, pide a un asistente de chat de IA que genere prompts fuertes para el inicio y el final de la pelea, luego utiliza esos prompts para la generación de tu video.

fr.content: Pour les scènes de combat dans Seedance, demandez à un assistant de chat IA de générer des prompts de combat forts pour l'ouverture et la fin, puis utilisez ces prompts pour la génération de votre vidéo.

ja.content:

ko.content:
---
Seedance에서의 전투 장면을 위해 AI 채팅 도우미에게 강력한 시작 및 종료 전투 프롬프트를 생성하도록 요청한 후, 해당 프롬프트를 비디오 생성에 사용하세요.

pt.content: Para cenas de luta no Seedance, peça a um assistente de chat de IA para gerar prompts fortes de abertura e encerramento de luta, e então use esses prompts para a geração do seu vídeo.

zh.content: 在Seedance中进行打斗场景时，可以请求AI聊天助手生成强有力的开场和结尾打斗prompts，然后使用这些prompts进行视频生成。
